searches.executionEvidence: Worker packet records actual result URLs and outcomes; root checked those records and cited first-party sources.

firstPartyChecks.observation: UN SALB first-party directory identifies Chad’s Service de la Cartographie, Direction du Cadastre as national geospatial/cadastral custodian.
Finance-hosted procedure was identified by the worker, but direct retrieval failed TLS validation; its detailed contents were not independently checked in this review.

custody.rootAssessment: National custodial identity is supported by the UN directory. Moundou-specific procedure detail remains worker-reported because the finance-hosted document was inaccessible; saved portal shells contain no parcel response. Registry custody is national, not a separately verified Moundou office.

scopeCaveat: No anonymous public native-ID/full-polygon response was independently verified. Restricted viewers, unavailable routes and portal shells do not show citywide parcel absence.
